verses.text: Paul, wey dem call to be apostle of Jesus Christ through God will, and our brother Sosthenes,

to di assembly of God wey dey Corinth; di people wey dem make holy for Christ Jesus, wey dem call to be saints, with all wey call di name of our Lord Jesus Christ for every place, both dem own and our own:
Grace to una and peace from God our Papa and di Lord Jesus Christ.
I always dey thank my God about una, for di grace of God wey dem give una for Christ Jesus;
say for everything una don rich inside am, for all expression and all knowledge;
even as di testimony of Christ don confirm inside una:
so that una no lack any gift; as una dey wait for di revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;
wey go confirm una too reach di end, without blame for di day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
God dey faithful, through whom dem call una enter di fellowship of im Pikin, Jesus Christ our Lord.

Now I beg una, brothers, through di name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, say make una all talk di same thing and say make no divisions dey among una, but make una dey perfect together for di same mind and for di same judgment.
Because dem don report to me about una, my brothers, by di people from Chloe household, say quarrels dey among una.
Now I mean this, say each one of una dey talk, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and “I follow Christ.”
Christ divide? Dem crucify Paul for una? Or dem baptize una into di name of Paul?
I thank God say I no baptize any of una, except Crispus and Gaius,
so that nobody go talk say I baptize una into my own name.
I baptize di household of Stephanas too; besides dem, I no know whether I baptize any other.
Because Christ no send me to baptize, but to preach di Good News—no with wisdom of words, so that di cross of Christ no go empty.
Because di word of di cross na foolishness to di people wey dey perish, but to us wey dey saved na God power.
Because e dey write, “I go destroy di wisdom of di wise, and I go bring di discernment of di discerning to nothing.”
Wia di wise dey? Wia di scribe dey? Wia di lawyer of this world dey? God no make di wisdom of this world foolish?
Because as for di wisdom of God, di world through im wisdom no know God, e please God through di foolishness of di preaching to save di people wey believe.
Because Jews dey ask for signs, Greeks dey seek wisdom,
but we dey preach Christ wey dem crucify; stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,
but to di people wey dem call, both Jews and Greeks, Christ na di power of God and di wisdom of God.
Because God foolishness wise pass men, and God weakness strong pass men.
Because una see una calling, brothers, say no plenty dey wise according to di flesh, no plenty mighty, no plenty noble;
but God choose di foolish things of di world so that e go shame di wise. God choose di weak things of di world so that e go shame di things wey strong;
and God choose di lowly things of di world, and di things wey dem despise, and di things wey no dey, so that e go bring to nothing di things wey dey:
so that no flesh go boast before God.
But from am, una dey for Christ Jesus, wey become wisdom from God for us, and righteousness and holiness, and redemption:
so that, as e dey write, “Di one wey boast, make e boast for di Lord.”
When I come to una, brothers, I no come with excellent speech or wisdom, dey proclaim God testimony to una.
Because I decide say I no go know anything among una, except Jesus Christ, and am wey dem crucify.
I dey with una for weakness, for fear, and with plenty trembling.
My speech and my preaching no be for persuasive words of human wisdom, but for demonstration of di Spirit and of power,
so that una faith no go stand for di wisdom of men, but for di power of God.
We dey talk wisdom, but, among di people wey don mature; yet wisdom wey no be of this world, or of di rulers of this world, wey dey come to nothing.
But we dey talk God wisdom for mystery, di wisdom wey don dey hidden, wey God plan before di worlds for our glory,
wey none of di rulers of this world know. Because if dem know am, dem no go don crucify di Lord of glory.
But as e dey write, “Di things wey eye no see, and ear no hear, wey no enter di heart of man, these ones God don prepare for di people wey love am.”
But to us, God reveal dem through di Spirit. Because di Spirit dey search all things, yes, di deep things of God.
Because who among men know di things of man, except di spirit of di man, wey dey inside am? Na so too, nobody know di things of God, except God Spirit.
But we receive, no be di spirit of di world, but di Spirit wey come from God, so that we go know di things wey dem freely give us by God.
We talk these things too, no be with words wey man wisdom teach, but wey Holy Spirit teach, as we dey compare spiritual things with spiritual things.
Now di natural man no dey receive di things of God Spirit, because dem na foolishness to am, and e no fit know dem, because dem dey spiritually discerned.
But di one wey dey spiritual dey discern all things, and nobody dey judge am.
“Because who don know di mind of di Lord, so that e go instruct am?” But we get Christ mind.
Brothers, I no fit talk to una as to spiritual people, but as to fleshly people, as to babies for Christ.
I feed una with milk, no with meat; because una no ready yet. Truly, even now una no ready,
because una still dey fleshly. Because as jealousy, strife, and factions dey among una, una no dey fleshly, and una no dey waka for di ways of men?
Because when one talk, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” una no dey fleshly?
So who be Apollos, and who be Paul, but servants through whom una believe; and each as di Lord give am?
I plant. Apollos water. But God give di increase.
So di one wey plant no be anything, or di one wey water, but God wey dey give di increase.
Now di one wey plant and di one wey water na one, but each go receive im own reward according to im own labor.
Because we be God fellow workers. Una be God farm, God building.
According to di grace of God wey dem give me, as wise master builder I lay foundation, and another dey build on am. But make each man careful how e dey build on am.
Because nobody fit lay any other foundation than di one wey dem don lay, wey be Jesus Christ.
But if anybody build on this foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;
each man work go dey revealed. Because di day go declare am, because e dey revealed for fire; and di fire imself go test wetin kind work each man work be.
If any man work wey e build on am remain, e go receive reward.
If dem burn any man work, e go suffer loss, but e imself go dey saved, yet like through fire.
Una no know say una be temple of God, and say God Spirit dey live inside una?
If anybody destroy di temple of God, God go destroy am; because God temple holy, wey una be.
Make nobody deceive imself. If anybody among una think say e wise for this world, make e become fool, so that e go become wise.
Because di wisdom of this world na foolishness with God. Because e dey write, “E don catch di wise for dem craftiness.”
And again, “Di Lord know di reasonings of di wise, say dem worthless.”
So make nobody boast for men. Because all things na una own,
whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or di world, or life, or death, or things wey dey now, or things wey dey come. All na una own,
and una na Christ own, and Christ na God own.
So make man think of us as Christ servants, and stewards of God mysteries.
For this matter, moreover, dem require say stewards go dey found faithful.
But to me e be very small thing say una go judge me, or say man judgment go judge me. Yes, I no dey judge my own self.
Because I no know anything against myself, yet no be by this dem justify me. But di one wey dey judge me na di Lord.
So judge nothing before di time, until di Lord come, wey go bring to light both di hidden things of darkness, and reveal di plans of di hearts. Den each man go get im praise from God.
Now these things, brothers, I don apply to myself and Apollos for una sake, so that for us una go learn no to go beyond di things wey dem write, so that none of una go proud against each other.
Because who make you different? And wetin you get wey you no receive? But if you receive am, why you dey boast like say you no receive am?
Una don full already. Una don become rich already. Una don begin rule without us. Yes, and I wish say una dey rule, so that we go rule with una too.
Because I think say God don display us, di apostles, last of all, like men wey dem sentence to death. Because dem don make us spectacle to di world, both to angels and to men.
We be fools for Christ sake, but una wise for Christ. We weak, but una strong. Una get honor, but we get dishonor.
Even to this present hour we dey hungry, thirsty, naked, dem dey beat us, and we no get certain place to stay.
We dey labor, dey work with our own hands. When people curse us, we dey bless. As dem dey persecute us, we dey endure.
As dem dey defame us, we dey plead. Dem don make us like di filth of di world, di dirt wey everybody wipe off, even until now.
I no dey write these things to shame una, but to warn una as my beloved pikin dem.
Because though una get 10,000 tutors for Christ, yet una no get many papa dem. Because for Christ Jesus, I become una papa through di Good News.
So I beg una, make una imitate me.
Because of this I don send Timothy to una, wey be my beloved and faithful pikin for di Lord, wey go remind una of my ways wey dey for Christ, even as I dey teach everywhere for every assembly.
Now some don proud, as if I no dey come to una.
But I go come to una soon, if di Lord willing; and I go know, no di word of di people wey proud, but di power.
Because God Kingdom no dey for word, but for power.
Wetin una want? I go come to una with rod, or with love and spirit of gentleness?
Dem dey really report say sexual immorality dey among una, and such sexual immorality wey dem no even name among di Gentiles, say one man get im papa wife.
Una don proud, and no rather mourn, so that di one wey do this deed go remove from among una.
Because I, as I dey absent for body but present for spirit, don already judge di one wey do this thing, as if I dey present.
For di name of our Lord Jesus Christ, as una gather together, and my spirit, with di power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
una go deliver such person to Satan for di destruction of di flesh, so that di spirit go dey saved for di day of di Lord Jesus.
Your boasting no good. Una no know say small yeast dey make all di lump rise?
Remove di old yeast, so that una go be new lump, even as una dey unleavened. Because truly our Passover don dey sacrificed for our place, Christ.
So make we keep di feast, no with old yeast, or with di yeast of malice and wickedness, but with di unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
I write to una for my letter say make una no mix with sexual sinners;
no mean at all di sexual sinners of this world, or di greedy and extortioners, or idolaters; because den una go need to leave di world.

But as e be, I write to una say make una no associate with anybody wey dem call brother wey be sexual sinner, or greedy, or idolater, or slanderer, or drunkard, or extortioner; with such person, no, no even to chop.
Because wetin I get to do with judging di people wey dey outside? Una no dey judge di people wey dey inside?
But di people wey dey outside, God dey judge. “Remove di wicked man from among yourselves.”
Anybody among una dare, as e get matter against im neighbor, go to law before di unrighteous, and no before di saints?
Una no know say di saints go judge di world? And if una dey judge di world, una no worthy to judge di smallest matters?
Una no know say we go judge angels? How much more, things wey concern this life?
So if una get to judge things wey concern this life, una dey set di people wey no count for di assembly to judge?
I talk this to shame una. No even one wise man dey among una wey fit decide between im brothers?
But brother dey go to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
So e already na total defect inside una, say una get lawsuits with each other. Why no rather make dem wrong una? Why no rather make dem cheat una?
No, but una yourselves dey do wrong, and dey cheat, and that against una brothers.

Or una no know say di unrighteous no go inherit God Kingdom? No dey deceived. Neither di sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men wey dey sell dem body for sex, nor men wey dey sleep with men,
nor thieves, nor greedy, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortioners, go inherit God Kingdom.
Some of una be like that, but dem wash una. But dem make una holy. But dem justify una for di name of di Lord Jesus, and for di Spirit of our God.
“All things dey lawful for me,” but no be all things dey profitable. “All things dey lawful for me,” but I no go let anything control me.
“Foods dey for di belly, and di belly for foods,” but God go bring to nothing both am and dem. But di body no be for sexual immorality, but for di Lord; and di Lord for di body.
Now God raise up di Lord, and go raise us up too by im power.
Una no know say una bodies na members of Christ? I go den take di members of Christ, make dem members of prostitute? E no go ever happen!
Or una no know say di one wey join prostitute na one body? Because, “Di two,” e talk, “go become one flesh.”
But di one wey join di Lord na one spirit.
Run from sexual immorality! “Every sin wey man dey do dey outside di body,” but di one wey commit sexual immorality dey sin against im own body.
Or una no know say una body na temple of Holy Spirit wey dey inside una, wey una get from God? Una no be una own,
because dem buy una with price. So give God glory with una body and with una spirit, wey be God own.
Now about di things wey una write to me: e good for man no to touch woman.
But, because of sexual immoralities, make each man get im own wife, and make each woman get im own husband.
Make di husband give im wife di affection wey di wife deserve, and na so too di wife to im husband.
Di wife no get authority over im own body, but di husband. Na so too di husband no get authority over im own body, but di wife.

No deprive each other, unless na by consent for some time, so that una go give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and go dey together again, so that Satan no go tempt una because una no get self-control.
But this I talk as concession, no as commandment.
Yet I wish say all men dey like me myself. But each man get im own gift from God, one for this way, and another for that way.
But I talk to di unmarried and to widows, e good for dem if dem remain even as I be.
But if dem no get self-control, make dem marry. Because e better to marry than to burn.
But to di married I command—no be me, but di Lord—say di wife no go leave im husband
—but if e leave, make e remain unmarried, or make e reconcile with im husband—and say di husband no go leave im wife.
But to di rest I—no be di Lord—talk, if any brother get unbelieving wife, and e dey content to live with am, make e no leave am.
Di woman wey get unbelieving husband, and e dey content to live with am, make e no leave di husband.
Because di unbelieving husband dem make holy for di wife, and di unbelieving wife dem make holy for di husband. If no be so una pikin dem go unclean, but now dem holy.
Yet if di unbeliever leave, make separation dey. Di brother or di sister no dey under bondage for such cases, but God don call us for peace.
Because how you take know, wife, whether you go save your husband? Or how you take know, husband, whether you go save your wife?
Only, as di Lord don distribute to each one, as God don call each, so make e waka. Na so I command for all di assemblies.
Dem call anybody wey don circumcise? Make e no become uncircumcised. Dem call anybody for uncircumcision? Make dem no circumcise am.
Circumcision no be anything, and uncircumcision no be anything, but di keeping of di commandments of God.
Make each man stay for that calling wey dem call am for.
Dem call you as bondservant? No let that trouble you; but if you fit become free too, use am instead.
Because di one wey dem call for di Lord as bondservant na di Lord free person. Na so too di one wey dem call as free na Christ bondservant.
Dem buy una with price. No become bondservants of men.
Brothers, make each man, for whatever condition dem call am, stay for that condition with God.
Now about virgins I no get commandment from di Lord, but I give my judgment as one wey don obtain mercy from di Lord to be trustworthy.
So I think say because of di distress wey dey on us, e good for man to remain as e be.
You dey bound to wife? No seek to free. You free from wife? No seek wife.
But if you marry, you no sin. If virgin marry, e no sin. Yet such people go get oppression for di flesh, and I want spare una.
But I talk this, brothers: di time short, so that from now, both di people wey get wives go dey as if dem no get any;
and di people wey cry, as if dem no cry; and di people wey rejoice, as if dem no rejoice; and di people wey buy, as if dem no possess;
and di people wey use this world, as if dem no dey use am to di fullest. Because di form of this world dey pass away.
But I want make una free from cares. Di one wey no marry dey concern about di things of di Lord, how e go please di Lord;
but di one wey marry dey concern about di things of di world, how e go please im wife.

Difference dey between wife and virgin too. Di unmarried woman dey concern about di things of di Lord, so that e go holy both for body and for spirit; but di one wey marry dey concern about di things of di world, how e go please im husband.
I talk this for your own profit, no say I want trap una, but for wetin suitable, and so that una go attend to di Lord without distraction.
But if any man think say e dey behave inappropriately towards im virgin, if e don pass di flower of im age, and if need require am, make e do wetin e want. E no dey sin. Make dem marry.
But di one wey stand firm for im heart, as e no get necessity, but get power over im own will, and don decide for im own heart to keep im own virgin, e do well.
So both di one wey give im own virgin for marriage do well, and di one wey no give am for marriage do better.
Law tie wife for as long as im husband dey live; but if di husband die, e free to marry whoever e want, only for di Lord.
But e happier if e stay as e be, for my judgment, and I think say I get God Spirit too.
Now about things wey dem sacrifice to idols: We know say we all get knowledge. Knowledge dey make person proud, but love dey build up.
But if anybody think say e know anything, e never know as e suppose know.
But if anybody love God, na im God know.
So about di eating of things wey dem sacrifice to idols, we know say no idol be anything for di world, and say no other God dey except one.
Because though things dey wey dem call “gods”, whether for di heavens or for earth; as many “gods” and many “lords” dey;
yet to us na only one God dey, Papa God, from whom all things come, and we for am; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things dey, and we dey live through am.
However, that knowledge no dey for all men. But some, as dem still dey conscious of di idol until now, dey chop am as thing wey dem sacrifice to idol; and dem conscience, as e weak, dey defiled.
But food no go commend us to God. Because neither, if we no chop, we worse; nor, if we chop, we better.
But make una careful say this liberty of una no become stumbling block to di weak.
Because if man see you wey get knowledge dey sit for idol temple, im conscience, as e weak, no go embolden am to chop things wey dem sacrifice to idols?
And through your knowledge, di one wey weak dey perish, di brother wey Christ die for.
So, as una dey sin against di brothers, and dey wound dem conscience when e weak, una dey sin against Christ.
So, if food make my brother stumble, I no go chop meat forever, so that I no go make my brother stumble.
I no free? I no be apostle? I never see Jesus Christ our Lord? Una no be my work for di Lord?
If to others I no be apostle, yet at least I be to una; because una na di seal of my apostleship for di Lord.
My defense to di people wey dey examine me na this.
We no get di right to chop and to drink?
We no get di right to carry wife wey be believer along, even as di rest of di apostles, and di brothers of di Lord, and Cephas?
Or na only Barnabas and I no get right to no work?
Which soldier ever dey serve with im own money? Who dey plant vineyard, and no dey chop im fruit? Or who dey feed flock, and no dey drink di flock milk?
I dey talk these things according to men? Or di law no talk di same thing too?
Because e dey write for di law of Moses, “You no go muzzle di ox when e dey tread out di grain.” Na for di oxen God dey care,
or e dey talk am for our sake? Yes, dem write am for our sake, because di one wey dey plow suppose plow for hope, and di one wey dey thresh for hope suppose share im hope.
If we plant spiritual things for una, e big thing if we harvest una fleshly things?
If others share this right over una, we no more? Still we no use this right, but we bear all things, so that we no go cause any hindrance to di Good News of Christ.
Una no know say di people wey serve round sacred things dey chop from di temple, and di people wey dey wait on di altar dey get dem portion with di altar?
Na so too di Lord order say di people wey dey proclaim di Good News suppose live from di Good News.
But I no use any of these things, and I no dey write these things so that dem go do am so for my own case; because e better for me to die, than say anybody go make my boasting empty.
Because if I preach di Good News, I no get anything to boast about, because necessity dey on me; but sorrow go dey for me, if I no preach di Good News.
Because if I do this by my own will, I get reward. But if no be by my own will, I get stewardship wey dem trust me with.
So wetin be my reward? Say when I preach di Good News, I go present di Good News of Christ without charge, so that I no go abuse my authority for di Good News.
Because though I free from all, I bring myself under bondage to all, so that I go win more.
To di Jews I become like Jew, so that I go win Jews; to di people wey dey under di law, as under di law, so that I go win di people wey dey under di law;
to di people wey no get law, as without law, though I no dey without law towards God, but I dey under law towards Christ, so that I go win di people wey no get law.
To di weak I become like weak, so that I go win di weak. I don become all things to all men, so that by all means I go save some.
Now I dey do this for di Good News sake, so that I go be joint partaker of am.
Una no know say di people wey run for race all dey run, but one dey receive di prize? Run like that, so that una go win.
Every man wey dey struggle for di games dey practice self-control for all things. Now dem dey do am to receive crown wey dey decay, but we, one wey no dey decay.
So I dey run like that, no as person wey no sure. I dey fight like that, no as person wey dey beat air,
but I dey beat my body and bring am under control, so that by any means, after I don preach to others, I myself no go dey disqualified.
